band.advice.critical: Hand off now. Every session in this size band hit a fatal error.
band.advice.high: Hand off soon. About a third of sessions in this band hit a fatal error.
band.advice.watch: Safe to continue, but keep an eye on it; about 17% of this band hit a fatal error.
cli.desc: Freeze a repository's current state into a lossless handoff (commit snapshot + plan backfill + handoff document).
cli.arg.repo: Repository path; defaults to the current directory
cli.arg.plan: Path to the plan document; omit to auto-detect the newest checkbox-bearing task document
cli.arg.out: Output path for the handoff file; defaults to the plan document's directory
cli.arg.message: Commit message; omit to generate one
cli.arg.no_commit: Do not commit; analyze and write the handoff file only
cli.arg.test_timeout: Timeout in seconds per test command; default 900
cli.arg.vitals: Only check local session transcripts and exit; never touches the repository
cli.arg.no_vitals: Skip the session check (no vitals table in the handoff file)
cli.arg.find: Locate a session by id fragment, directory fragment, or opening-prompt keyword
cli.arg.limit: Maximum transcripts to scan per agent; default 12
cli.arg.force: Ignore concurrent-write warnings and continue (only when you know no other session is running)
cli.arg.dry_run: Print what would happen without writing any file
cli.arg.lang: Interface and output language: zh-Hans / zh-Hant / en; omit to follow the system locale
cli.arg.gui: Launch the local web interface (browser-driven, equivalent to every CLI feature)
cli.arg.port: Web interface port; 0 picks a free port automatically
cli.arg.no_browser: Start the web interface without opening a browser
cli.arg.jobs: Parallelism; 0 decides from the CPU count
cli.arg.json: Emit results as JSON for scripts to consume
cli.step.plan: [2/6] Locating and parsing the plan document
cli.step.score: [3/6] Scoring completion from file and symbol evidence
cli.plan.no_intent: [note] No Goal / Constraints style intent section found in the plan; a fresh session may not know the overall goal. Consider adding one by hand.
cli.plan.missing: No plan document found (skipping backfill; the handoff file is still written)
cli.err.not_repo: Error: {path} is not a git repository. The handoff relies on git metadata.
cli.err.no_git: Error: no executable git found. Every piece of evidence this tool produces comes from git, so install git and make sure it is on PATH.
cli.conc.detected: Another session may be writing this repository right now:
cli.conc.readonly: Not touching git this run; continuing (analysis only).
cli.conc.stopped: Stopped without changing anything. Two writers on one worktree loses work:
cli.conc.reason1: our git add can bury what they staged,
cli.conc.reason2: their commit --amend can rewrite the commit we just made.
cli.conc.howto1: Confirm that session has stopped, let it commit or commit by hand, then rerun.
cli.conc.howto2: To continue anyway once you know there is no conflict: add --force
cli.conc.howto3: To write only the handoff file and leave git alone: add --no-commit
cli.commit.docs_msg: docs: backfill plan completion and record the handoff
cli.commit.clean: Worktree is already clean; nothing to commit.
cli.commit.nothing_staged: Nothing staged (every change may belong to a protected file); no commit made.
cli.tests.none: No test command detected (no pyproject.toml / package.json, or no usable test script)
cli.vitals.worst: Session vitals: most urgent {agent} {file} {mb} MB fatal={fatal} -> {band}
cli.vitals.none: No session transcripts found (neither ~/.claude/projects nor ~/.codex/sessions exists).
cli.vitals.no_path: The transcript carries no usable path; confirm by hand which project it belongs to.
cli.vitals.not_repo: Not a git repository; run git init, or point at the real project root.
cli.vitals.once: Several sessions on one repository still need only one run - a handoff freezes repository state, not the conversation.
cli.sessions.picked: Selected {count} session(s); their digests go into the handoff file.
cli.arg.sessions: extract these transcripts' content into the handoff and prompt; repeatable
cli.arg.pick_sessions: interactively pick which sessions to carry over
cli.pick.head: Recent sessions on this machine. Pick the ones related to this repo.
cli.pick.hint: Enter numbers separated by comma/space (e.g. 1,3,4). Empty = none. 'a' = all.
cli.pick.related: (★ marks sessions whose transcript mentions this repo)
cli.pick.none: No session picked; the handoff will not carry session content.
cli.vitals.rest: The other {count} transcripts (largest first, no action needed):
cli.find.hint: Try: the first 8 characters of a session id, part of a project directory name, or a word from the opening prompt.
cli.find.same_repo: These sessions all point at one repository: {repo}
cli.find.multi_repo: Several repositories involved; hand off one at a time (one run each):
cli.find.no_repo: Could not infer a git repository from the transcripts; name it explicitly: agent-handoff <project-path>
cli.card.thread_id: source thread {value} (this session was forked from / resumed it)
cli.card.digest: Digest    carries a {chars}-char compaction summary, extractable
cli.card.aborted: ! aborted {count} turn(s) were interrupted; that work may be half-done
cli.prompt.banner: Opening prompt for the new session (copy the whole block)
cli.race.warn: [warning] HEAD moved under us while this ran:
cli.race.explain1: Another session is writing at the same time. The HEAD in the prompt above may be stale,
cli.race.explain2: so wait for that session to stop and run this again.
conc.staged: {count} files are already staged and this run did not stage them. Another session most likely ran git add without committing.
env.venv_broken: `{name}/` is not a usable virtualenv (no executable Python, only {detail}). Do not delete or repair it; use a different interpreter.
env.no_test_script: `{pkg}` has no `test` script; the real names are {names}. Running `npm test` will report Missing script.
env.foreign_registry: `{lock}` mixes in the non-official registries {mirrors}, which can break cross-environment reproducibility.
env.git_dirty_submodule: `{path}` is a submodule with uncommitted changes; the parent commit will not carry them, so the next session may see an inconsistent tree.
doc.title: # {repo} handoff ({date})
doc.generated: > Generated by agent-handoff. Every conclusion comes from command output, file existence, or symbol search;
doc.generated2: > anything unverified is labeled as such.
doc.not_substitute: > **This file does not replace the plan document.** The original requirements and hard limits live in `{plan}`;
doc.not_substitute2: > read that in full first, then come back here for the current state.
doc.scene.head: - HEAD: `{head}`
doc.scene.ahead: - Local is **{count}** commits ahead of remote, **none pushed**
doc.protected: Files the plan declares user-owned and this run kept out of the commit:
doc.step2.note: > Completion only answers "how far did it get". What to build and what not to touch live in the plan's {sections} sections; this table does not carry them.
doc.table.head: | Task | Done / To do | File evidence | Symbol evidence | Verdict |
doc.step3.skipped: No tests ran this time (--skip-tests was used, or no test command was detected).
doc.vitals.basis: Ranked by transcript size and fatal-error markers. The thresholds come from the measured distribution of 54 Claude and 54 Codex transcripts on this machine: nothing under 250 KB carried a fatal error, everything over 8 MB did.
doc.vitals.head: | Agent | Session | Size | Fatal | Aborted | Tool errors | Verdict |
doc.sessions.intro: Sessions the user chose to carry over. Each digest was written by that session itself during context compaction — it is a primary record, not this tool's inference. Treat the conclusions as established facts.
doc.sessions.thread: - Origin thread id: `{value}` (this session forked from / resumed it)
doc.sessions.asks: **What the user actually said in that session (verbatim; outranks any paraphrase):**
doc.sessions.last_prompt: **The session stopped on this user input:**
doc.sessions.digest: **Handoff digest written by the session itself:**
doc.h.prompt: ## Opening prompt for the new session
doc.prompt.howto: Paste the whole block below into the new session's input box. **Do not** paste this file's contents alongside it -
doc.prompt.howto2: it already lives in the repository; let the agent read it, so you do not repeat the context overflow.
doc.plan_missing: No plan document found, so completion backfill was skipped.
prompt.identity: Repo identity (use this on another machine, not the local path above): {remote} @ {sha}
prompt.no_remote: This repo has no remote and exists only on this machine; continue on the same machine.
prompt.unpushed: {count} commit(s) are unpushed - a fresh clone will not have them; do not assume the remote does.
prompt.intent_sections: Do not just scan the checkboxes - the {sections} sections carry this project's original requirements and hard limits,
prompt.intent_sections2: and you must absorb them before touching anything; they define what counts as done and what must never change.
prompt.read_plan_plain: First thing: read {plan} in full, including the goal and constraints at the top; do not just scan the checkboxes.
prompt.then_handoff: Then read {handoff} for the current state and the known gaps.
prompt.handoff_only: First thing: read {handoff} for the current state; do not redo finished work.
prompt.fix_failing: Fix these failures first and get the suite green:
prompt.sessions.head: Prior sessions ({count}). Their full digests are in the handoff file:
prompt.sessions.howto: Do not re-derive or contradict what these sessions already concluded; see the 'Prior sessions' section of {handoff} for each full digest, and read the transcripts above only if you need finer detail.
prompt.sessions.lossy: Note: this is a digest handoff, not the original session. Tool approvals, background processes, MCP connections and the reasoning behind rejected approaches did not travel. Absence from the digest is not evidence of absence - verify against the state above before acting.
prompt.protected: - {path} is a user-owned file; never modify, move, delete, or package it
prompt.expiry: (This prompt was generated at {now} against HEAD {head}. If the repository has taken new commits since, rerun agent-handoff for a fresh prompt instead of reusing this one.)

gui.sessions.picked: Selected — will be written into the handoff

gui.handoff.opt.skip_tests: Skip tests (minutes faster, but no test evidence in the handoff)
gui.handoff.opt.no_vitals: Leave out the session vitals table
gui.handoff.running: Running; a large project can take a few minutes...
gui.handoff.prompt_title: Opening prompt for the new session
gui.handoff.prompt_hint: Copy the whole block into the new session. The handoff file is already in the project - do not paste it too.
gui.find.title: Find a session
gui.find.lead: Enter the first characters of a session id, part of a project folder name, or a word from the opening prompt.
gui.guide.title: Guide
gui.err.title: Something went wrong

gui.label.head: HEAD
